units.source_text: 续弈日期既定，睡眠不足是区区小事，不能成为推延对局的理由。

en.t: Once the date for resuming the game had been set, lack of sleep was a trivial matter and could not be a reason to postpone the match.

units.source_text: 即使遇上双亲临终，或者自己病倒在棋盘上，也要遵守对局的日子，这是棋手的惯例。

en.t: Even if one's parents were on their deathbed, or if one fell ill over the board, a player was expected to keep the appointed day of the game; that was the custom among go players.

units.source_text: 如今这种例子也并不鲜见。

en.t: Even today, examples of this are by no means rare.

units.source_text: 何况临到对局的早上才抱怨，如此任性，纵使是名人也是不该。

en.t: All the more so, complaining only on the morning of the match was such willfulness that even the Master should not have allowed himself it.

units.source_text: 因为这是一场重要的棋赛。

en.t: For this was an important match.

units.source_text: 对七段来说，这盘棋就更重要了。

en.t: For the seventh-dan player, this game was even more important.
